verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade into stacked Hemorrhage, you win if you poke with Q and never let him lock you down at level 6.

brief.thesis: Darius wants you in auto-attack range to stack Hemorrhage and land Apprehend (E) pulls; Gnar wants to throw Q (Boomerang Throw) from range and only enter melee range as Mega Gnar. The 50.9% win rate over 2094 games reflects a lane that's even on paper but swings hard on whether you respect his E hook cooldown and his all-in timing at level 6.

theirWindow.what: He will walk up to passive-proc range baiting you to trade, then sweep Apprehend to pull you in and follow with R (Noxian Guillotine) for true damage scaled off your stacks. Do not auto-trade here even if you're in Mini Gnar form with Rage banked.

yourWindow.what: This is your only safe engage window. Walk up, land free autos and Q (Boomerang Throw) for the slow, and disengage before he can Crippling Strike (W) you to cut off your retreat.

powerCurve.note: Both weak, respect his Decimate (Q) healing radius
Boomerang Throw poke outranges his kit entirely
Noxian Guillotine + E pull threatens solo kills
Mega Gnar transform trades evenly with Hemorrhage
R (GNAR!) wall-stun swings teamfights your way

start.why: sustains through his Decimate pokes and the extra AD keeps your auto-trades relevant before Trinity Force comes online

boots.why: Darius's entire kit is physical damage autos and axe swings; the flat reduction blunts his stacked Hemorrhage ticks

core.why: the move speed and empowered auto synergize with Hyper (W) procs to keep you kiting in and out of his E range
armor shred stacks on top of his own Apprehend passive, but the CDR and health let you survive his all-in windows
the shield and AD scaling cover the exact burst pattern of his R (Noxian Guillotine) executing through stacked passive

situational.when: he is building crit or you need the active slow to peel off his Apprehend pull
he is ahead and you need the magic resist plus on-hit to keep trading through his healing
he is fed and healing heavily off Decimate blade hits

runes.keystoneWhy: the heal and move speed proc let you poke with Q and immediately kite out of his engage range, which is the entire win condition of this lane

summoners.why: Flash is mandatory to dodge his E (Apprehend) hook at the moment it fires, and Teleport lets you reset off bad trades or stacked Hemorrhage without conceding the wave to a melee all-in champion

playing.title: Never auto-trade in melee
playing.detail: Every auto you take from him stacks Hemorrhage toward his passive enrage. Throw Boulder/Boomerang (Q) from max range and walk away instead of matching autos.

playing.title: Track his E (Apprehend) cooldown
playing.detail: It's 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s. If it's down, you can safely step into auto range; if it's up, stay outside 535 range entirely.

playing.title: Respect level 6 all-in
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage scaling with your Hemorrhage stacks. Do not take unnecessary autos from him right before level 6 hits.

playing.title: Save transform for his engage, not yours
playing.detail: Mega Gnar's W (Wallop) stun and E (Crunch) slam are your answer to his E pull. Bank Rage so you transform defensively when he commits, not proactively.

playing.title: Use R to end fights at walls
playing.detail: GNAR! only matters near terrain. Position trades near lane walls so R threatens a stun, not just a knockback.

playing.title: Freeze when ahead, shove when losing
playing.detail: Since solo-kill advantage sits with Darius, avoid freezing the wave near your tower where he can engage freely; shove and reset off cooldowns instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and summoner picks are pulled from measured OP.GG data on patch 16.19.1 across 2094 games; the trade-pattern and cooldown-tracking advice is my own tactical read of the kit interactions.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with (E) by keeping your distance. Kite him or use [R] when you are Mega Gnar to fight him as you cannot defeat him head on.
